_comment_user: Who D.A.V.E. is working for. address_as is what he calls you — 'sir', your first name, or "" for none.
_comment_personality: wit: dry | light | off. pushback: firm | gentle | off. See references/persona.md.
_comment_redmine: authority: read-only | propose-writes | auto-routine. 'propose-writes' means D.A.V.E. actively drafts ticket updates and time logs but never sends one without a yes.
_comment_kanban: Boards are pasted or screenshotted in by hand — D.A.V.E. has no API to them. List them so he knows what he is missing when one goes stale.
_comment_priorities: max_now caps how many things may sit in the Now section. drift_threshold_minutes is how long unlisted work runs before D.A.V.E. says something.
_comment_projects: The project layer. root is where your work lives; with autodiscover on, `project list` names unregistered directories under it as candidates without adding them. use_gh lets a scan read PRs via the gh CLI where a remote is GitHub. Cadence per project is what stops the weekly review from treating every quiet repo as a problem.
_comment_time: max_segment_minutes caps an open focus when time is read. A focus left set overnight is reported as four hours and flagged, never as sixteen. Time with no log activity inside it is reported separately rather than folded into the total — an over-counting ledger is worse than none, because Scribe is forbidden from estimating hours and will quote this.
_comment_review: The weekly sweep. promise_horizon_days is how far ahead brief looks for commitments coming due.
_comment_hooks: session_start injects your current focus and Now list as context at the start of every Claude Code session. Set false to make D.A.V.E. speak only when invoked.
_comment_roster: Which specialist agents D.A.V.E. may delegate to. Remove any you don't want him reaching for.
_comment_models: Which model each agent runs on. Overrides the agent's own default; an explicit model on a single call overrides this. haiku for mechanical transformation, sonnet for structured analysis, opus where depth decides correctness. Set "inherit" to use the main session's model.
